#Import libraies and methods
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
source("submissions/BasicImplementation/bootstrap.R")
```

#Clean up data
```{r}
# Load Data
lizard_data <- read.csv("submissions/BasicImplementation/data.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

# Inspect data
print(head(lizard_data))

#Clean names replace . with _ between word spaces,
#remove white spaces and lowercase
clean_names <- tolower(gsub(" ", "_", trimws(gsub("\\.+", " ", colnames(lizard_data)))))
print(head(clean_names))

#Remove rows with missing sex, snout_vent_length_mm or body_temprature
clean_data <- clean_names %>% 
    filter(
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(snout_vent_length_mm),
    !is.na(body_temperature))
```
